jessica_support: Heads-up — ticket #54321. Customer says applying a new promo overwrote their existing trial credit instead of stacking. They had $30 trial credit, applied PROMO-SPRING and now only see $50 (the new promo) — the $30 disappeared. Can we investigate?

jessica_support: Repro steps I ran in staging: 
1) create test account acct_test_57
2) apply promo A (trial) via admin UI -> 200 OK
3) apply promo B (promo credit) via API: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/accounts/acct_test_57/promos 
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk.test' 
 -d '{"code":"PROMO-SPRING"}'
```
Response: `{\"status\":\"applied\", \"active_promos\":[\"PROMO-SPRING\"], \"credit_total\":50}`
Expected active_promos to include both promo A and B and credit_total 80.
I exported account rows from DB (masked) and the account_promos table only has one active row (promo B).

omkar_engineer: Can you paste the account id + timestamps and the exact responses from the apply API (headers + body)? Also were these promos different "types" (trial vs credit) or same type?

jessica_support: Account: acct_test_57. API request id: req_20260314_0923. Both promos are type=CREDIT in promos table; promo A is legacy-trial (created 2022-09-10) promo B created 2026-03-13. Promo metadata snapshots: promo A missing stack_policy field, promo B has stack_policy=STACKABLE.

lena_cs: Noting: legacy promos created before v2 of promo service didn't get stack_policy set. Default behavior last year was to REPLACE unless explicitly marked stackable. We migrated promo UI but maybe the apply logic treats NULL as REPLACE.

billing_bot: promo-normalizer job executed 2026-03-14T08:12:34Z — updated 12 promo rows to set stack_policy=REPLACE where NULL. Job run id: job_7842.

marco_billing: I ran a quick query for acct_test_57: 
```sql
SELECT id, promo_code, stack_policy, applied_at 
FROM account_promos 
WHERE account_id='acct_test_57';
-- result: only promo B row (promo A missing); applied_at for promo B = '2026-03-14 09:23:11'
```
Looks like apply path removed the legacy row. I can share the full audit log lines if needed (masked).

omkar_engineer: Thanks. Two likely issues: (1) apply_promo code is using stack_policy NULL => fallback to REPLACE; (2) promo-normalizer may have backfilled REPLACE which made legacy promos non-stackable. Need to verify ordering: did normalizer run before or after the customer's apply? billing_bot shows normalizer earlier this morning. If normalizer set legacy promos to REPLACE, then apply would behave as replace.

omkar_engineer: Can you paste the apply_promo function call in staging? Specifically the branch that merges account_promos. If we treat NULL as STACKABLE we risk changing historical semantics. Prefer to keep current behavior but patch UI to set stack_policy explicitly during promo creation and make admin UI warn.

jessica_support: Pasted the relevant log excerpt (sanitized): 
```
applyPromo(req=req_20260314_0923) -> fetch promo B meta -> stack_policy='STACKABLE'
fetch existing account promos for acct_test_57 -> found promo A with stack_policy=NULL
evaluate stacking: if existing.stack_policy == 'REPLACE' or new.stack_policy=='REPLACE' -> remove existing; else -> add
// since existing.stack_policy == NULL, code treated NULL as REPLACE (legacy fallback)
perform DB upsert -> account_promos now only contains promo B
```

marco_billing: Here's a safe SELECT to find affected accounts: 
```sql
SELECT ap.account_id, array_agg(ap.promo_code) FROM account_promos ap
JOIN promotions p ON ap.promo_id = p.id
WHERE p.stack_policy IS NULL OR p.stack_policy='REPLACE'
GROUP BY ap.account_id
HAVING count(*) < (SELECT count(*) FROM promotion_history ph WHERE ph.account_id=ap.account_id);
```
This should surface accounts where promos may have been replaced.

omkar_engineer: Proposed immediate actions: 
- Manual fix: credit impacted accounts the missing amounts (support to send credits). Jessica/lena to patch ticket for customer.
- Short-term fix: change apply_promo to treat NULL as STACKABLE for credits only, but behind feature flag so we can roll back.
- Long-term: run a migration to backfill stack_policy for legacy promos based on original intent (promo metadata in jira/marketing docs) and a one-off reconciliation script to re-apply lost credits where appropriate.

omkar_engineer: Example patch snippet (pseudo): 
```go
// current
if promo.StackPolicy == "REPLACE" || existing.StackPolicy == "REPLACE" {
  removeExisting()
} else {
  addPromo()
}
// suggested (feature-flag guarded)
existingPolicy := existing.StackPolicy
if existingPolicy == "" { existingPolicy = "STACKABLE" } // treat NULL as stackable for credits
if promo.StackPolicy == "REPLACE" || existingPolicy == "REPLACE" { removeExisting() } else { addPromo() }
```

emily_oncall: We should not automatically change semantics globally without PM approval. Immediate customer relief: Jessica — please grant 30 credit back to the customer and note it in ticket. Also send a short apology and explanation (we're investigating).

jessica_support: Done — manually granted $30 credit to acct_live_89 and updated ticket with apology + credit proof. Ticket updated at 2026-03-14 10:01 UTC.

sara_pm: Can we get an inventory of promos with NULL stack_policy and the marketing owners? We need to decide default behavior per promo class before any migration. Also propose a small UX change: required explicit "stackable" checkbox when creating promos via UI.

omkar_engineer: I'll open a PR for the feature-flagged apply change + reconciliation script. ETA: PR by end of day, staging test tomorrow, rollout to prod after PM signoff (estimate 48h). I'll post links once created.

lena_cs: Thanks — I'll coordinate marketing owners and curate the list. Jessica — please include language for customer comms templates.

jessica_support: Copy — I'll post the reply template here after we finalize wording. 

omkar_engineer: Follow-up: job job_7842 (promo-normalizer) will be paused until we agree rules; I've created a temp hold: job_7842 -> paused_by=eng_incident. Leaving notes here. :eyes:
